spans.s: पुत्रट् (1) the word पुत्र as given in the ancient list of masculine words marked with the mute letter ट् to signify the addition of the fem. affix ई ( ङीप् ): cf.

: (2) the substitute पुत्रट् ( i. e. पुत्री ) for the word दुहितृ optionally prescrib- ed after the words सूत, उग्र, राज, भोज, कुल and मेरु in the simple sense of 'girl' and not * daughter ' e. g. राजपुत्री, सूतपुत्री: cf.
